_comment: SYNTHETIC demo patient. No real protected health information. This file holds raw record data only; derived fields (risk_factors, history_multiplier, baseline_vulnerabilities, timeline) are computed by the History Agent in Phase 2, not stored here. A record that represents a durable clinical finding carries a `normalised` block: the coded form the History Agent consumes, so it never has to parse report prose. There is deliberately no separate top-level prior_findings list — that would be a second copy of facts already present in medical_records, and the two would drift.

patient.notes: Reference case for the respiratory MVP scenario: prior pulmonary abnormality plus an acute febrile respiratory presentation with falling SpO2.

medical_records.title: Chest X-ray — right lower lobe focal opacity

detail.report_text: PA and lateral chest radiograph. There is a focal area of increased opacity in the right lower lobe. No pleural effusion or pneumothorax. Cardiac silhouette normal in size. Impression: focal right lower lobe opacity, clinical correlation recommended.
detail.indication: Persistent productive cough and low-grade fever for 10 days

normalised.label: focal_opacity
normalised.description: Focal increased opacity, right lower lobe

medical_records.title: Follow-up chest X-ray — prior opacity resolved

detail.report_text: Follow-up PA chest radiograph. The previously noted right lower lobe opacity has resolved. A subtle residual fibrotic streak is present at the right base. No new consolidation. Impression: interval resolution of prior right lower lobe opacity with residual fibrotic change.

current_symptoms.free_text: Fever and a dry cough that started two days ago. Breathing feels harder each day, especially when walking to the bathroom. Chest feels tight.

current_imaging.provenance: Preset structured finding for synthetic patient PT-DEMO-001 (MVP demo scenario). No imaging model was executed.
findings: Patchy increased opacities in both lower zones, right greater than left
Residual fibrotic streak at the right base, unchanged since 2025-06-20
